title: Myth vs Fact: Do Chemical Drain Cleaners Fix Clogs Safely?
description: Many property owners rely on liquid chemical drain cleaners as a quick solution for stubborn clogs. However, harsh chemical drain openers often cause severe, hidden damage to drainage systems. These strong acids or caustic chemicals produce exothermic heat during chemical reactions, which can warp, soften, or crack plastic PVC and ABS drain lines, while damaging older metal traps. Furthermore, if the chemical fails to clear the obstruction, it leaves a dangerous pool of caustic liquid in the line, creating serious hazards for technicians. Mechanical cleaning methods, such as drain augers or removing the P-trap, offer a safer, more reliable solution.
